description: This is a PHP source file defining a class `Smarty_CacheResource_Pdo` that implements a cache resource handler for Smarty templates using a PDO-connected database. The class provides methods to fetch, save, delete, and manage cached template content stored in a database table.

classes.name: Smarty_CacheResource_Pdo
classes.description: A class providing a PDO-based cache resource handler for Smarty template caching system, allowing cache data to be stored, retrieved, and managed within a relational database.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PDO cache resource with a PDO connection, table name, and optional database name.

methods.name: fillStatementsWithTableName
methods.description: Populates SQL statements with the correct table name.

methods.name: getFetchStatement
methods.description: Prepares and returns a PDO statement to fetch cached content based on provided identifiers and columns.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Retrieves cached content and its modification time from the database.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Stores cache content into the database, updating if a record exists.

methods.name: inputContent
methods.description: Encodes the content before saving to the database (identity function here).

methods.name: outputContent
methods.description: Decodes the content when retrieving from the database (identity function here).

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes cache entries from the database based on provided criteria or clears all.

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Returns the properly formatted table name, including database if specified.
